items.title: Netizens in China hunt for access to open internet as VPNs drop out
items.description: People in China say it is increasingly difficult to access the open internet, but they continue to find ways around Beijing's censorship apparatus.

items.title: Canberra Liberals say former leader's claim she was threatened with assault was 'misunderstanding'
items.description: The Canberra Liberals have distanced themselves from former leader Leanne Castley's allegation that she was threatened with physical assault, saying the remark related to an "animated discussion" that was quickly resolved.

items.title: Sydney nurses' alleged threats 'stupid things said by stupid people', court told
items.description: A lawyer acting for one of two Sydney nurses accused of making antisemitic threats via an online video chat app has told a court their actions were "stupid things said by stupid people".

items.title: Chinese spies using LinkedIn to steal secrets from recruits, Five Eyes warns
items.description: Australia and its partners in the Five Eyes intelligence alliance warn that Chinese spies are using job platforms to post fake ads to lure recruits with access to sensitive information.

items.title: Paedophile ex-magistrate Peter Liddy leaves prison after 25 years
items.description: Notorious paedophile ex-magistrate Peter Liddy has taken his first steps of freedom after serving a 25-year prison term for the sexual abuse of four children.

items.title: PM says Australia has 'ideological disagreement' with US after it reveals anti-slavery tariff
items.description: The planned new tariff is to be slapped on dozens of countries that have allegedly failed to take action to prevent slavery and forced labour.

items.title: US House votes to rein in Trump on Iran war
items.description: The US House of Representatives delivers President Donald Trump a rare rebuke, voting to halt military action in his war with Iran.

items.title: Elderly NSW couple stabbed, alleged intruder shot during home invasion
items.description: Two people in their 70s have been critically injured and an alleged intruder has been shot during an alleged home invasion in northern NSW this morning.

items.title: Live: Lower house passes first tranche of Labor's budget measures
items.description: The federal government's budget bill passes the House of Representatives without amendment, but it will need the support of the Greens to pass the next step. Follow live.

items.title: The streaming platform exploding in popularity
items.description: Whether or not you've heard of the livestreaming platform Kick, there’s a good chance you’ll have seen clips from it. Kick has become home to some of the internet's most controversial creators — from celebrities and manosphere influencers to looksmaxxers.  But what is Kick, and why has it become such a major player in livestreaming?

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
